snippet.title: Rhapsody in Scarlet - Announcement Trailer (ESRB) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
Magic Never Misses a Beat

Set in the jazz-filled streets of 1920s New York, magus Ellie Myers embarks on a journey to confront a threat that could shake the world. 
Experience exhilarating combat and stack up combos with beasts and magick in this all-new action adventure game!
